verdict.rationale: Custom assistants are a fair axis for an AI answer product, but the evidence shows no user-facing way to build an assistant with its own instructions and knowledge base, or to share one. The closest item is Agent API 'profiles' (reusable, versioned configurations). That is a developer API primitive with no documented instructions, knowledge attachment or sharing, so it earns no credit here. Library and Discover are adjacent features, not custom assistants.
